Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. To proceed with our internal approvals we need a succinct statement and some operational evidence that the processing for our account will be EU-only (data plane and inference) under the standard SCCs mapping. Primary asks: 1) confirmation that backups and snapshot restores for our tenant remain in-region (EU), 2) who (operator role) can access logs and when, and 3) a short list of the subprocessor chain for any cross-border telemetry.

Hi Daniela / Novamed team —

Thanks — we can confirm the following at a high level and will follow up with the artifacts attached: see Novamed_SCCs_Mapping_v1.pdf and inregion-op-access-matrix.csv. Key points:  

- Data plane: inference requests, model KV caches, and customer-generated content are processed in EU-only regions for the account we discussed (tenant tag: novamed-eu-78321).
- Backups & snapshots: automated backups for your tenant are stored in-region (EU) and are subject to the same retention/deletion controls as live data; we do not export backup snapshots outside EU for this tenant by default.
- Operator access: operator roles are tightly scoped. Two operator categories may have rare temporary access for emergency debugging: (1) Platform SRE with ticketed authorisation (requires double-approval) and (2) Product on-call for rollout issues. Access is logged, audited, and retained per the SCCs mapping.
- Subprocessors: we listed immediate subprocessors that handle orchestration, object storage, and telemetry in the attached mapping. Any cross-border telemetry is pseudonymized and limited to aggregated usage metrics — we call that out in the mapping.

Next steps: 1) Please confirm whether Novamed needs signed attestations / an operator affidavit (we can provide a template), 2) confirm an evidence package scope (audit logs for a 30-day window vs. full snapshots), and 3) desired timeline for the procurement/legal review.

I've attached the mapping and the access matrix as discussed. Happy to jump on a short call if you want a walkthrough.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
